guide.title: Small-support partition and likelihood functions
guide.summary: declared finite supports (points of 1..3 coordinates, NULL a category) and models over them: categorical (exact rational weights or probabilities per request) and exponential families h(x) exp(theta . T(x)) with rational features; the retained statistics are a DIST-001 histogram aligned to the declared support (zero masses kept, an observed value outside it refused, products of marginals only under a GEN-002 independence declaration); batches of parameter requests give Z, log Z, the log-likelihood (-inf for a zero-probability point with mass), its gradient and Hessian: exact rationals for categorical models, CALC-003 / DIST-003 certified enclosures accumulated as exact 128-bit scaled integers for exponential families, equal on the CPU and in CUDA.

PROB-001.cpu: Native C (math_prob.c; the per-point terms inline in math_prob.h): declared supports (1..3 coordinates, logical int64 values or NULL, sorted natively into DIST-001 cell order, duplicates refused, exact-content identity); models with features T stored as int64 numerators over per-feature lcm denominators: categorical (weights or exact probabilities per request, one-hot natural parameters when no features) and exponential families with a rational base measure h >= 0 (zero everywhere refused). Retained statistics: a DIST-001 histogram (dense or sparse, count or nonnegative weight masses, declared listwise NULL exclusion) aligned to the declared support without reading a row: per group the mass of every declared point (zeros kept), N, rows, dropped mass; an observed cell outside the support is refused naming it; the state records the support, the histogram's scope digest and GEN-002's data source and grouping. Products of two states (the CROSS JOIN within groups over the product support) only under a GEN-002 declaration covering a shared source (tr_conv_decl_covers; reasons needs_declaration, not_covered, grouping_differs, keys_differ). Plans validate every request (own status) and compute CALC-003's 64.192 reduction constants theta_j / (D_j ln 2) from floor(2^512 / ln 2); sums per request: categorical exact 128-bit W, W T, W T T sums (bit-length proof, else OverflowError) and DIST-003-logarithm bounds of sum n ln W at a proven scale; exponential families an exact maximum of the binary exponents n_i + bitlen(H_i), then CALC-003's tr_calc_exp2_reduce per point, (H_i / 2^bitlen) m_i 2^(n_i + bitlen - n_ref) in 120-bit midpoint-radius fixed point, outward floor / ceil integers of S_0, S_j, S_jl at scales s = min(120, 124 - bitlen(d)) - b_j - b_l that prove every partial sum below 2^126. The finish (shared by both backends, sums checked against the proofs) gives Z (exact form [zlo, zhi] 2^zexp / zden and outward doubles, [DBL_MAX, inf] past the range), log Z and the transcendental part of the log-likelihood as exact 256-bit bounds at 2^-120 (a 128-bit extension of DIST-003's logarithm: hi - lo <= E + 149 ulps), the log-likelihood as -inf with a flag when a zero-probability point has mass (never a finite number), and the gradient Tobs - N E[T] and Hessian -N Cov[T] with exact 256-bit numerators from the corners of the sums' boxes (exact rationals for categorical models); tr_prob_exact gives the exact rational bounds of every entry with FND-009 big integers. Every budget is checked before allocation.
PROB-001.gpu: math_prob_gpu.cu, tr_mgpu_prob_sums: one work item per (request, 64 support points). Exponential families: launch 1 computes n_i + bitlen(H_i) (the integer part of CALC-003's reduction) with a local maximum and one tr_atomic_max_i64 per request; launch 2 the CALC-003 exponentials, the outward integers of every wanted sum term and local 128-bit sums flushed with one exact two-word tr_atomic_add_wide per bound. Categorical models: one launch of the exact sums and the DIST-003 log bounds with the same atomics. Exponent overflows and zero-probability points with mass are flags set by atomic OR. Every term is an exact integer and every partial sum is proven below 2^126, so the device sums, reference exponents and flags equal the CPU's bit for bit whatever the thread order (emulated with a scrambled order in the tests); the host finishes both with the same tr_prob_finish.
budgets: Support: variables = k, support = d, bytes; models: variables = m, support = d, tensor = d m, bytes; statistics: support = d, states = G d, bytes (with the support and the source descriptor); products: support = da db, states = G da db, bytes.

Evaluation: output = n x (3 + gradient entries + Hessian entries), tensor = n d, states = n x sums, bytes = the plan (680 bytes of reduction constants per exponential request, 8 d per categorical request), the sums and the finish scratch; CUDA: bytes = every device copy, states = n x sums; exact bounds: bytes of every big integer.
Refusals before allocation (AlgebraBudgetError with resource, need, limit); sizes past 64 bits are refused whatever the budget; at most 3 coordinates, 16 features, 2^32 points (UnsupportedError).
limitations: Features, base measures and parameters are rationals whose common denominators and numerators fit int64 (OverflowError otherwise); categorical sums need bitlen(d) + bitlen(max W) + bitlen(max |feature product|) <= 126, a conservative bit-length proof that can refuse admissible requests.

Exponents are limited to CALC-003's 2^(2^24) range (OverflowError per request beyond); double enclosures of Z leave the double range as [DBL_MAX, inf] or [0, 2^-1074] (the exact form and log Z stay finite); the double enclosures of gradients and Hessians add several ulps to the exact bounds.

Interval bounds of the gradient and Hessian treat the sums as independent boxes (dependency not exploited): rigorous, about 2^-100 relative to the moments, wider in relative terms when a covariance nearly cancels; a variance's upper bound is clamped at 0.
Weight masses are logical integers (scaled by 10^wscale) with a group total below 2^64; the statistics are dense per group over the declared support (G x d masses).

Products of statistics combine two states of 1..2 coordinates into at most 3, within groups (the CROSS JOIN); the independence declaration is the caller's statement, never verified against the data, and states without a data source (merged histograms) cannot be multiplied.
No FND-007 certificate is emitted: the support containment is checked natively at construction and reported as a refusal (FND-007 has no claim kind for membership in a finite set).
The benchmark's second case (factorized inference: graph size, elimination width, intermediate support and precision) belongs to PROB-002 and is not measured here.
